title: Native targets
summary: The same client source can build a browser application. It can also build a desktop or mobile application that shows the bundle in the WebView of the platform. The bundle is the built web files. A WebView is a browser view inside an app. One command can build several targets: `ty bundle --target macos,ios`. Each native target needs its platform software development kit (SDK), compiler and WebView dependencies. This release is a release candidate: no target has the supported tier yet, and `docs/SUPPORT_TIERS.md` in the Tachyon repository records how far each target has been tested (buildable, simulator-tested or native-tested).
